main.description: The accounts an organization (any account keeping a dev.knotless.org record) invited, as the appview has indexed its records. To anyone, those who are members in public: named by a dev.knotless.orgMember record in its public records, taken in, and keeping a public dev.knotless.orgAcceptance record naming it. Optional authentication: to the organization itself and to its members, its invitations and hidden members too, from its space; to an account it invited, its own entry.

errors.description: No account by that DID or handle.
errors.name: ProfileNotFound

gateway.description: The gateway its public dev.knotless.org record names, which members join and leave through, and admins change its members through.

inside.description: Whether the asker sees its invitations and hidden members: it is the organization, or one of its members.

members.description: The first invited first: to an asker inside, every account it invited; to anyone else, its members in public.

organization.description: Whether the account is an organization: it keeps a public dev.knotless.org record.

actor.description: The organization, by DID or handle.

memberView.description: An account an organization invited, and where it stands.

expiresAt.description: When the invitation lapses, when its record says.

joinedAt.description: When the organization took it in.

role.description: What it may do: an admin also invites and removes members.

standing.description: Invited and not yet a member; invited, and the invitation lapsed; a member anyone may see; or a member only the organization's members see.
